new_value: {"design":"Supersedes decision mimid-1wgh.5.70. draft-ietf-mimi-protocol-07 §7.5 (upstream PR #168): \"All indices in changedRoleParticipants and removedIndices refer to the participants vector at the end of the epoch in which the proposal is sent, as with MLS Remove proposals. This holds even when a commit contains more than one ParticipantListUpdate. Removing one entry does not shift the indices of the other removals.\" Each update in a commit is validated and resolved against the epoch-start list: role changes in place, removed entries dropped, additions appended in commit order. An update is invalid if any index is out of range, an index repeats in changedRoleParticipants or in removedIndices, an index is in both, or an added user is already in the epoch-start list. A commit is invalid if its updates together add, remove or change the role of the same user (by user bytes) more than once. Any invalid update rejects the commit; a rejected update applies nothing. Residual spec gap, no decision needed: \"already in the participant list\" does not say which list; mimid uses the epoch-start list, and a user touched by an earlier update in the same commit is rejected by the same-user rule either way (only the error variant could differ).","issue_type":"decision","title":"ParticipantListUpdate indices refer to the epoch-start list across a commit (protocol-07 §7.5)"}
